messages:
emma: quick read on the graph cards—i'm not loving 'p99: 1.2k' on the axis label. '1.2k' is fine in data tables but axis ticks should be full units or have a clear unit suffix. suggestion: show full numbers on y-axis for top tick + compact ticks for interior, and a legend unit like 'ms (k = 1,000)'.

ryan: agree. current auto-abbrev feels inconsistent across zoom levels. what about a toggle in chart settings: Units -> [Automatic | Full | Compact]? default Automatic but with a tooltip explaining behavior.

leo: if we add a toggle, we need copy that fits in the UI: for compact mode, label 'Short numbers (k, M)'; for full mode 'Exact values'. also, accessibility: when screen reader reads ticks, say 'one thousand two hundred milliseconds' not 'one point two k'.

morgan: UX nit on smoothing: product asked smoothing be applied visually but still show raw points as faint markers. prototype shows raw points hidden. ops wants to see suppressed spikes. propose: show raw points as 20% opacity hollow dots, smoothed line solid. add legend entry: 'Raw samples (faint)'.

emma: yes to showing raw points. also for outliers, instead of clipping them we should render them as semitransparent vertical markers with label 'outlier'. if many outliers cluster, aggregate into a small badge '+12 outliers'.

ryan: technical note: rendering dozens of outlier badges will be noisy. maybe use thresholding: show individual outlier markers when zoom level < 30s per pixel, otherwise show aggregated badge. we should document zoom thresholds.

leo: copy proposals for legend and hover: legend compact: 'Raw • Smoothed • Outliers'; hover microcopy for point: 'Raw: 2,412 ms (outlier) • Smoothed: 950 ms'. keep hover concise.

ux-bot: interaction suggestion: keyboard focus order: chart region -> legend toggle -> unit selector -> export button. when chart focused, Right/Left arrow moves time window, Up/Down changes y-axis scale (if scale locked off). Add aria-live for tooltip content.

morgan: accessibility nit on color: Avoid using only color to mark outliers. use a thin vertical bar + black outline and pattern for high-contrast mode. also ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for any text in the badge.

emma: small animation nit: when smoothing toggled, animate smoothed line morph over 200ms to make it clear data changed. but keep animations reduced when 'prefers-reduced-motion' is set.

ryan: dev constraints: morphing across large data points could be heavy. limit animation to visible window and interpolate only path commands. fallback to crossfade if too complex.

leo: question on exports: product says exported CSV should always contain raw samples with timestamp and value columns, plus computed smoothed_value and outlier_flag columns. confirm?

morgan: yes. never mutate authoritative export. add metadata header row: '# units: ms; smoothing: off; outlier_threshold: 3sigma' for clarity.

emma: final checklist for handoff: 1) unit selector copy + tooltip, 2) legend compact wording and accessible labels, 3) raw faint points + outlier marker rules + aggregation threshold, 4) keyboard focus & shortcuts, 5) export CSV schema + header. i'll update the figma and link it here. :thumbsup: 

ux-bot: design doc created: https://confluence.redwood/design/chart-units-outliers-1716601230 (includes accessibility checklist and mockups).
